title: Reconcile-and-Adopt Conformance Spec
status: Phase 1 implemented (foundation + bleeding-stop). Adoption = Phase 2/3, TODO.
description: Typed contract both layers (Layer A: bot.py, Layer B: NestJS) implement against. Defines order/position field shapes, match keys, adoption states, and the canonical event names emitted into the SignalCycleEvent stream and bot.py audit log. Phase 1 implements the bleeding-stop subset (cancel orphan orders, surface foreign orders, heal cancel-by-exchange). Adoption states RECONCILE_ADOPT_* are declared here as the contract for Phase 2/3.

layerA.name: Layer A — showcase trading bot (bot.py)
layerA.ownership: canonical showcase signal source. Phase 3 will add adoption hooks here. NOT edited in Phase 1.

layerB.name: Layer B — NestJS Live Copy relay (signal-subscriber-execution.service.ts)
layerB.runtime: node :7800 (Live Copy subscriber), reads bot bridge :7810
layerB.ownership: subscriber-side reconciliation. Phase 1 + Phase 2 live here.

bitfinexOrderId.source: Bitfinex v2 REST order id (row[0] of /auth/r/orders)
bitfinexOrderId.notes: Primary match key for resting limit orders and stop orders. Stored in ExecutionPayload.bitfinexOrderId / stopOrderId and in bot.py order ledger.

clientOrderId.notes: Client-assigned order id. Surface-only in Phase 1 (BitfinexActiveOrder parser does not currently expose cid). Phase 2 may extend the parser to surface cid for cross-layer matching.

amount.source: Bitfinex v2 row[6] — REMAINING amount on the book
amount.notes: amount == 0 means fully filled or cancelled. amount < amountOrig means partial fill.

amountOrig.notes: filled = amountOrig - amount. Used by Phase 1 money-path guard: if filled > 0 do NOT cancel (defer to fill reconcile).

price.source: Bitfinex v2 row[16]|row[14] — limit / aux limit price

status.source: Bitfinex v2 row[13] — order status (ACTIVE, PARTIALLY FILLED, CANCELED, EXECUTED, etc.)
status.notes: Phase 1 only inspects presence in listActiveOrders (active set); the status string is surfaced to operators via dashboardState.orphanOrderIds but not yet branched on.

amount.notes: abs(amount) compared against ledger open qty to compute reconcile delta.

bitfinexOrderId.description: Exact Bitfinex order id match. Highest confidence. Used by Phase 1 cancel logic and the orphan-exit guard.

clientOrderId.description: Client-assigned cid match. Phase 2/3 may use this to adopt orders placed by the other layer without a shared server-side id.

cycleIdUserId.description: Composite (cycleId, userId) match against SignalCycleParticipant. Used to attribute fills to ledger rows.

fuzzy.description: Side + qty + price-band match for unattributed fills (reconcileUnattributedExchangeFills). Last resort.

WILD.description: Order/position exists on the exchange but no layer claims it. Surface-only in Phase 1 (dashboardState.orphanOrderIds).
WILD.phase1Action: surface to dashboardState.orphanOrderIds; block new Live Copy entries; do NOT auto-cancel.

CLAIMED_BY_A.description: Order placed by Layer A (bot.py). Layer B should mirror, not adopt, while A is alive.
CLAIMED_BY_A.phase1Action: n/a (Layer A orders are not Layer B's to cancel)

CLAIMED_BY_B.description: Order placed by Layer B (NestJS Live Copy). Tracked via managedOrderIds set in evaluateEntryEligibility / reconcileLotLedger.
CLAIMED_BY_B.phase1Action: tracked; cancels on normal exit and on orphan-exit (Item 1).

ORPHAN_LEDGER.description: Ledger open qty > exchange position qty. The exchange-side lot is gone (stop fired, partial external close, or cancel-by-exchange) but the ledger row is still OPEN.
ORPHAN_LEDGER.phase1Action: closeOrphanLedgerLots cancels leftover bitfinexOrderId + stopOrderId (with fill guard) and records ORPHAN_LEDGER_RECONCILE EXIT + ORPHAN_LEDGER_RECONCILE_CANCEL audit event.

CANCEL_BY_EXCHANGE.description: PENDING_ENTRY participant whose bitfinexOrderId vanished from listActiveOrders with no FILLED event. The exchange cancelled/expired the order without filling.
CANCEL_BY_EXCHANGE.phase1Action: reconcileCancelByExchange marks participant CLOSED at $0 PnL and records RECONCILE_CANCEL_BY_EXCHANGE EXIT event.

RECONCILE_ADOPT_A_TO_B.description: Layer B adopts an order originally placed by Layer A (e.g. bot.py crashed mid-place, NestJS continues managing it).

RECONCILE_ADOPT_B_TO_A.description: Layer A adopts an order originally placed by Layer B (e.g. Live Copy relay died, bot.py takes over the resting order).

RECONCILE_ADOPT_FILLED.description: Adoption of an already-filled order whose PnL must be attributed to the correct layer/ledger.

ORPHAN_LEDGER_RECONCILE_CANCEL.purpose: Dedicated audit row recording exactly which Bitfinex oids were cancelled at orphan-exit time, separate from the EXIT row.

payloadFields.dashboardState.orphanOrderIds: Array<{ id, amountRemaining, amountOrig, price, status, orderType }>

RECONCILE_FOREIGN.purpose: Surface WHICH foreign Bitfinex order to cancel so the operator doesn't have to guess from a count. Auto-cancel is intentionally NOT performed in Phase 1.

RECONCILE_CANCEL_BY_EXCHANGE.purpose: Heal PENDING_ENTRY rows that hang forever when the exchange cancels/expired an order the API expected to fill. Marks CLOSED at $0 PnL (no fill = no PnL).

RECONCILE_ADOPT_A_TO_B.purpose: Record that Layer B adopted an order originally placed by Layer A.

RECONCILE_ADOPT_B_TO_A.purpose: Record that Layer A adopted an order originally placed by Layer B.

RECONCILE_ADOPT_FILLED.purpose: Attribute a fill to the adopting layer for PnL/success-fee accounting.

S1.name: Orphan ledger lot (ledger > exchange)
S1.phase1Coverage: Item 1 — closeOrphanLedgerLots cancels leftover bitfinexOrderId + stopOrderId with fill guard, emits ORPHAN_LEDGER_RECONCILE + ORPHAN_LEDGER_RECONCILE_CANCEL.

S2.name: Foreign/unmanaged resting order on the exchange
S2.phase1Coverage: Item 2 — evaluateEntryEligibility surfaces ids into dashboardState.orphanOrderIds (surface-only). New entries blocked. No auto-cancel.

S3.name: Cancel-by-exchange on a PENDING_ENTRY with no fill
S3.phase1Coverage: Item 3 — reconcileCancelByExchange marks CLOSED at $0 PnL, emits RECONCILE_CANCEL_BY_EXCHANGE.

S4.name: Stuck PENDING_ENTRY with a FILLED event (heal to OPEN)

S6.name: Immediate exchange flat (manual or stop close)

S7.name: Adopt Layer A order into Layer B ledger

S8.name: Adopt Layer B order into Layer A bot.py ledger

moneyPathInvariants: Every cancel is preceded by a findOrder state check; if filled > 0 the order is NOT cancelled (defer to fill reconcile).
Every cancel is wrapped in try/catch — a 404/nonce error must not crash the reconcile loop.
Every cancel emits an audit event with the cancelled oids.
Cancel-by-exchange healing only fires for participants older than 120s to avoid racing order placement.
Cancel-by-exchange healing requires the bitfinexOrderId to be absent from BOTH listActiveOrders AND a direct findOrder (defense against transient nonce gaps).
Cancel-by-exchange healing requires NO FILLED event in the participant's history (filled rows are healed by healStuckPendingFill with real PnL).
